Dave Matthews Band
November 18, 2022
Madison Square Garden - New York, NY

*=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=*
*=*=*=*=* 16/48 RECORDING *=*=*=*=*
*=* NOT SUITABLE FOR CD BURNING *=*
*=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=*

Mixing: Zachary Semcken
Source: AKG C414 XLII (Hypercardioid) > MixPre 10 II (32 Bit Float @ 96)
Location: Inside FOH, Slightly House Right of DFC, Mics PAS @ ~15'
Editing: WAV > Reaper 6.70 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing, Resample 32/48) > WAV (32 Bit Float @ 48) > Audacity 3.2.1 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

Setlist:

01. Intro
02. When the World Ends
03. You Might Die Trying
04. You Never Know
05. Can't Stop
06. If Only
07. Rooftop
08. So Damn Lucky¹
09. The Riff
10. What Would You Say
11. The Ocean and the Butterfly
12. Crush²
13. Squirm
14. Louisiana Bayou
15. Lying in the Hands of God³
16. Why I Am
17. Lie in Our Graves⁴⁵
18. Stay (Wasting Time)⁶
19. Ants Marching⁷⁸
20. Encore Break
21. Some Devil
22. Grey Street⁹

Set Time: [02:48:06.282]

Dave Matthews Band:

Dave Matthews - Guitar, Lead Vocals
Tim Reynolds - Electric Guitar
Stefan Lessard - Bass
Buddy Strong - Keyboards, Vocals
Rashawn Ross - Trumpet, Vocals
Jeff Coffin - Saxophone, Flute
Carter Beauford - Drums

Notes:

¹ Thank You (Falettinme Be Mice Elf Agin) interpolation
² Stefan solo intro; Theme from New York, New York interpolation
³ American Baby Intro and Bourbons & Lacs interpolations
⁴ with Louis Cato on Electric Guitar & Vocals
⁵ No Reprise
⁶ with Louis Cato on Electric Guitar, Louis Fouché on Alto Sax, and Jon Lampley on Trumpet
⁷ with Louis Fouché on Alto Sax and Jon Lampley on Sousaphone
⁸ Carter solo intro; Shake Your Body (Down to the Ground) interpolation
⁹ St. Thomas interpolation

Major shout out to Greg Mendelsohn for the clamp space and being the best taping buddy a guy can ask for. 

Huge thanks to the DMB Crew for letting Greg & I set up a stand in the cage and being incredibly supportive of live taping.

This recording is dedicated to all the tapers that have taught me to love archiving live music.

Compiled on 2022/11/19.
